offering_description.value: Provides telecommunications and broadband services across Alaska, including wireless, internet, cable television, and data and managed network services. Sells to consumers, businesses and government, delivering services over its own fiber, cable and wireless network.

primary_products.value: mobile devices; set-top boxes and modems

primary_services.value: wireless service; broadband internet; cable television; data networking; managed IT services

customer_segment.value: B2C: Alaska households and individual consumers; B2B: businesses, carriers and healthcare providers; B2G: government agencies, school districts and rural health systems

end_markets.value: telecommunications; media and entertainment; education; healthcare; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly wireless, internet and cable TV plans; product sales: mobile devices and customer equipment; service fees: managed network and IT services; project or contract: network build and government or enterprise connectivity contracts
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs fiber, cable and wireless network in Alaska, takes in network investment and sells capacity to customers; service provider: sells connectivity and managed services to consumers, businesses and government

geography_served.value: US regional: Alaska statewide, including remote communities

specialization.value: related lines: wireless, broadband, cable TV, data and managed IT services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff selling to consumers, businesses and government; own locations: company retail stores in Alaska; online: online account and plan sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed telecom carrier regulated by the FCC and the Regulatory Commission of Alaska

notes: The company merged into Liberty Broadband in late 2020 and no longer operates as a separate public company; this describes its Alaska operations.
divestiture_lines: P2.19: Liberty Broadband Corporation and GCI Liberty, Inc. completes the spin-off of GCI Liberty from Liberty Broadband.
